records.statement: `doctor` reports host, platform, and runtime diagnostics in both a human rendering and `--json`, and does so regardless of whether the workspace carries a valid devcontainer configuration.
records.notes: The pinned reference exposes no `doctor` command — see ext-doctor-diagnostics. Independence from the workspace configuration is the property worth pinning: `doctor` is what a user reaches for when something is wrong, so refusing to run because the configuration is broken would remove it exactly when it is needed.
